name: No Viable Option Exists - Safe Escalation
description: Total disruption with zero viable alternative suppliers and zero transit routes capable of arriving in time. System safely falls back to HOLD and triggers executive escalation.
report_text: CATASTROPHIC INCIDENT: Complete port strike and quarantine at Singapore Global Distribution Center (SITE-SIN-08). All outgoing maritime and air cargo lanes suspended for 30 days. No secondary supplier has certified capacity. Severity: 5.
test_purpose: Safe failure mode: When no option is viable, system never hallucinates a miracle; it chooses HOLD and triggers escalation.
